name: Aid

components.material: a tiny strip of white cloth

description: Up to three creatures of your choice within range each gain 5 temporary hit points for the duration. When you cast this spell using a higher-level slot, each target gains 5 additional temporary hit points for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Alter Self
description: You assume a different form. You choose one of the following options, the effects of which last for the duration: Aquatic Adaptation, Change Appearance, or Natural Weapons.

name: Arcane Lock

components.material: gold dust worth 25 gp

description: You touch a closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway, and it becomes locked for the duration. You and the creatures you designate when you cast this spell can open the object normally.

name: Augury

components.material: specially marked sticks, bones, cards, or similar tokens worth 25 gp

description: By casting gem-inlaid sticks, rolling dragon bones, laying out ornate cards, or employing some other divining tool, you receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about results of a specific course of action within the next 30 minutes: Weal, Woe, Weal and Woe, or Nothing.

name: Barkskin

components.material: a handful of oak bark

description: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin has a rough, bark-like appearance, and its AC can't be less than 16, regardless of what kind of armor it is wearing.

name: Blindness/Deafness
description: You can blind or deafen a foe. Choose one creature that you can see within range to make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, the target is blinded or deafened (your choice) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a Constitution saving throw; a successful save ends the effect.

name: Blur
description: Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you. For the duration, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with truesight.

name: Calm Emotions
description: You attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of people. Each humanoid in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must make a Charisma saving throw; on a failure, choose one of two effects: suppress charmed/frightened conditions, or make the creature indifferent about creatures of your choice.

name: Crown of Madness
description: One humanoid of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you for the duration. While charmed, a twisted crown of jagged iron appears on its head, and it must use its action to make a melee attack against another creature of your choice. On each of your turns, you must use your action to maintain control; otherwise the spell ends.

name: Darkness

components.material: bat fur and a drop of pitch or piece of coal

description: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere for the duration. The darkness spreads around corners and is impenetrable to darkvision. Light created by spells of 2nd level or lower can't illuminate the area.

name: Darkvision

components.material: a pinch of dried carrot or an agate

description: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

name: Detect Thoughts

components.material: a copper coin

description: For the duration, you can read the thoughts of certain creatures. When you cast the spell and as your action on each turn until the spell ends, you can focus your mind on any one creature within 30 feet that you can see. If the creature has an Intelligence of 3 or lower or doesn't speak any language, it is unaffected.

name: Enhance Ability

components.material: fur or a feather from a beast

description: You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement. Choose one of the following effects: Bear's Endurance (advantage on Con checks, +2d6 temporary HP), Bull's Strength (advantage on Str checks, double carrying capacity), Cat's Grace (advantage on Dex checks, no fall damage up to 20 ft), Eagle's Splendor (advantage on Cha checks), Fox's Cunning (advantage on Int checks), or Owl's Wisdom (advantage on Wis checks).

name: Enlarge/Reduce

components.material: a pinch of powdered iron

description: You cause a creature or an object you can see within range to grow larger or smaller. Choose enlarge (target doubles in size, advantage on Strength checks and saves, +1d4 damage with weapon attacks) or reduce (target halves in size, disadvantage on Strength checks and saves, -1d4 damage with weapon attacks).

name: Enthrall
description: You weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see within range to make a Wisdom saving throw. Any creature that can't be charmed succeeds automatically. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks while you remain within range.

name: Flaming Sphere

components.material: a bit of tallow, a pinch of brimstone, and a dusting of powdered iron

description: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range and lasts for the duration. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

name: Gentle Repose

components.material: a pinch of salt and one copper piece placed on each of the corpse's eyes

description: You touch a corpse or other remains. For the duration, the target is protected from decay and can't become undead. The spell also effectively extends the time limit on raising the target from the dead, since days spent under the effect of this spell don't count against the time limit of spells such as raise dead.

name: Gust of Wind

components.material: a legume seed

description: A line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Strength saving throw; on a failed save, a creature is pushed 15 feet away. A creature that starts its turn in the line must also succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet. The gust disperses gas or vapor and extinguishes flames.

name: Heat Metal

components.material: a piece of iron and a flame

description: Choose a manufactured metal object within range. You cause the object to glow red-hot. Any creature physically in contact with the object takes 2d8 fire damage. On each of your turns for the duration, you can use a bonus action to cause this damage again. If a creature is holding or wearing the object and takes the damage, it must drop or remove the object or have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

name: Hold Person

components.material: a small, straight piece of iron

description: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw; on a success, the spell ends on the target. You can target one additional humanoid for each spell slot level above 2nd.

name: Invisibility

components.material: an eyelash encased in gum arabic

description: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2nd.

name: Knock
description: Choose an object that you can see within range. The object can be a door, a box, a chest, a set of manacles, a padlock, or another object that contains a mundane or magical means that prevents access. A target that is held shut by a mundane lock or stuck or barred becomes unlocked, unstuck, or unbarred.

name: Lesser Restoration
description: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

name: Levitate

components.material: either a small leather loop or a piece of golden wire bent into a cup shape

description: One creature or object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically up to 20 feet and remains suspended there for the duration. The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface. The spell ends if you are incapacitated. The target can make a Constitution saving throw if it is an unwilling creature.

name: Locate Object

components.material: a forked twig

description: Describe or name an object that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the object's location, as long as that object is within 1,000 feet of you. If the object is in motion, you know the direction of its movement. The spell can't locate an object if any thickness of lead blocks the path.

name: Magic Weapon
description: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. When you cast this spell using a 4th-level slot or higher, the bonus increases to +2; using a 6th-level slot or higher, the bonus increases to +3.

name: Mirror Image
description: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the spell ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions. Each time a creature targets you with an attack, roll a d20 to determine whether the attack instead targets one of your duplicates. A duplicate's AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier.

name: Misty Step
description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

name: Moonbeam

components.material: several seeds of any moonseed plant and a piece of opalescent feldspar

description: A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-tall cylinder centered on a point within range. Any creature that enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 radiant damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

name: Pass without Trace

components.material: ashes from a burned leaf of mistletoe and a sprig of spruce

description: A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection. For the duration, each creature you choose within 30 feet of you (including you) has a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can't be tracked except by magical means.

name: Prayer of Healing
description: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range each regain hit points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs. When you cast this spell using a higher-level slot, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Protection from Poison
description: You touch a creature. If it is poisoned, you neutralize the poison. For the duration, the target has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned, and it has resistance to poison damage.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
description: A black beam of enervating energy springs from your finger toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the spell ends. At the end of each of the target's turns, it can make a Constitution saving throw to end the spell.

name: Rope Trick

components.material: powdered corn extract and a twisted loop of parchment

description: You touch a length of rope that is up to 60 feet long. One end of the rope then rises into the air until the whole rope hangs perpendicular to the ground. At the upper end of the rope, an invisible entrance opens to an extradimensional space that lasts until the spell ends.

name: Scorching Ray
description: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray; on a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage. You create one additional ray for each spell slot level above 2nd.

name: See Invisibility

components.material: a pinch of talc and a small sprinkling of powdered silver

description: For the duration, you see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane, out to a range of 60 feet.

name: Shatter

components.material: a chip of mica

description: A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from a point of your choice within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d8 thunder damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. A creature made of inorganic material has disadvantage on this saving throw.

name: Silence
description: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to thunder damage, and creatures are deafened while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a verbal component is impossible there.

name: Spider Climb

components.material: a drop of bitumen and a spider

description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free. The target also gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed.

name: Spiritual Weapon
description: You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the weapon up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. The weapon deals 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier force damage on a hit.

name: Suggestion

components.material: a snake's tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil

description: You suggest a course of activity to a creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. The suggestion must be worded so as to make the activity sound reasonable. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw; on a failed save, it pursues the course of action to the best of its ability for the duration.

name: Web

components.material: a bit of spiderweb

description: You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point of your choice within range. The webs fill a 20-foot cube from that point for the duration and are difficult terrain. A creature that starts its turn in the webs or that enters them during its turn must make a Dexterity saving throw; on a failed save, the creature is restrained while in the webs.
